description: Crawl a website and extract every image URL it references. Supports `` tags, ``/``, `srcset` candidates, and CSS `background-image` declarations.

imageExtensions.description: Only image URLs whose path ends in one of these extensions are kept. Drop entries to filter to a subset (e.g. only ['svg']) or extend with custom formats.
imageExtensions.title: Image extensions to accept

includeBackgroundImages.description: Also extract images referenced via inline `style="background-image: url(...)"` attributes. Disable to only collect ``-sourced images.
includeBackgroundImages.title: Include CSS background-images

maxCrawlDepth.description: 0 = only the start URL. 1 = also follow links found on the start URL (same host only). Higher values widen the crawl but cost more time.
maxCrawlDepth.title: Maximum crawl depth

maxImagesPerPage.description: Cap on how many images are extracted from a single page. Pathological gallery pages can list hundreds of duplicates; this keeps runs bounded.
maxImagesPerPage.title: Maximum images per page

maxTotalImages.description: Hard cap on the total number of image records pushed across all crawled pages. The crawl stops once this many images are emitted.
maxTotalImages.title: Maximum images per run

startUrl.description: The page to start crawling from (e.g. 'https://example.com'). The actor extracts images from this page and, if `maxCrawlDepth >= 1`, follows internal links to additional pages on the same host.
startUrl.title: Start URL

userAgent.description: Override the default Chrome User-Agent string. Most sites accept the default; only set this if a target server filters by UA.
userAgent.title: Custom User-Agent (optional)

title: Website Image Scraper Input
